lines.text: Many learners say: Will it rain? I think no.
Better: Will it rain? I don't think so.
The second! I don't think so.

data.wrong: Will it rain? I think no.
data.right: Will it rain? I don't think so.
data.memory: Will it rain? I don't think so.

native.tip: Türkçede “Bence hayır.” deriz; İngilizcede “I think no” denmez, “I don't think so.” denir.
native.caption: “Will it rain? I think no” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede “sanmıyorum” demek için “I don't think so” kullanılır. Doğrusu “Will it rain? I don't think so.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “I don't think so”. “Hayır” yerine “I don't think so” de. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: Say “I don't think so.” and not “I think no.”
en.caption: Do you say “Will it rain? I think no”? 😅 To say no politely we say “I don't think so”, not “I think no”. The right sentence is “Will it rain? I don't think so.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
